name: Picsart
knownFor: A widely used all-in-one photo and video editor with retouching, background removal, templates, and AI image tools. It can also generate images, but it is not on the Image generation page.
popCaption: 16.5M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026); 1.2M US App Store ratings, #12 in Photo & Video · checked Nov 2026
learn: Everyday photo, video, and design edits in one app
pro: Huge distribution on web and mobile, with a real editor rather than a single-effect app
con: Also generates images, so it sits next to the Image generation section without being listed there
costCaption: Typical plan: Pro $15/month, or $10.50/month billed yearly, labeled most popular (picsart.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026).

name: Photoroom
knownFor: An AI photo editor aimed at product photos and listings: background removal, studio-style shots, batch edits, and related tools.
popCaption: 18.2M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026); 232K US App Store ratings. The official App Store listing says it is trusted by over 300 million users · checked Nov 2026
pro: Built for sellers who need clean backgrounds and listing-ready images, not only selfies
con: The 300 million users figure is a vendor claim, not a third-party count
costCaption: Typical plan: Pro $7.50/month billed yearly, labeled most popular (photoroom.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026).

name: FaceApp
knownFor: A mobile face editor known for one-tap aging, hair, makeup, and other photorealistic face filters.
popCaption: 1.8M US App Store ratings at 4.7 average (apps.apple.com, FaceApp: Perfect Face Editor, checked Nov 2026). Website visits under-count this mobile-first app.
learn: One-tap face filters and portrait retouching
pro: A very large mobile audience and a long-standing reputation for realistic face edits
con: Pro prices are shown only inside the app, so there is no public individual price list
costCaption: Editorial estimate for a typical individual paid plan in the $$ band. FaceApp Pro is sold in-app through the App Store or Google Play; FaceApp publishes no public price list (faceapp.com/faq, checked Nov 2026).

name: Facetune
knownFor: A mobile retouching app for portraits and selfies, with AI headshots and other appearance tools.
popCaption: 436.3K web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). Official site cites 338K App Store reviews and 765K Google Play reviews (facetuneapp.com/pricing) · checked Nov 2026
pro: A dedicated retouching app with a very large review base on both phone stores
con: Website visits still under-count app use; official prices may vary by store and offer
costCaption: Typical plan: Yearly $77.99/year (about $6.50/month), labeled most popular; monthly starts at $25/month (facetuneapp.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026).

name: Reface
knownFor: A face-swap app for photos and short videos, with AI avatars and photo animation (including singing photos).
popCaption: 1.8M Google Play ratings (play.google.com, Reface: Face Swap AI Generator, checked Nov 2026). Official site cites 474,468 Apple App Store reviews at 4.8 (reface.ai/unboring). 260.4K web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026).
learn: Face swap in photos and short videos
pro: A well-known dedicated face-swap app with a large mobile audience
con: Web plan prices on Unboring may not match in-app mobile prices; web traffic under-counts the app
costCaption: Typical plan: web Basic $7.58/month billed annually as $90.99 (a $113.99 figure was shown struck through). Premium is $9.99/month billed annually as $119.99 (reface.ai/unboring, checked Nov 2026). Mobile app prices may differ.

name: Remini
knownFor: A photo enhancer and restorer that sharpens old, blurry, or low-resolution photos, now also used for AI portraits.
popCaption: 360K US App Store ratings at 4.6 average, #75 in Photo & Video (apps.apple.com, checked Nov 2026); 388.8K web visits to app.remini.ai in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026).
learn: Restoring and sharpening old or blurry photos
pro: A well-known one-tap enhancer with a large mobile audience
con: Subscription offers vary in-app, and Remini publishes no single public price list
costCaption: Editorial estimate for a typical individual paid plan in the $$ band. The US App Store lists Remini Pro Weekly at $9.99, Remini Lite Weekly from $4.99, and a 1 Month plan at $9.99 (apps.apple.com, checked Nov 2026). Offers vary.

name: Fotor
knownFor: A web and app photo editor with collages, retouching, restoration, and AI generation tools. It can also generate images, but it is not on the Image generation page.
popCaption: 5.8M web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Browser photo editing with AI helpers
pro: A long-standing editor with substantial website traffic
con: Official individual plan prices did not load as text this session, so the cost band is an estimate
costCaption: Editorial estimate for a typical individual paid plan in the $ band. No public individual price captured this session · checked Nov 2026

name: Lensa
knownFor: A mobile photo editor known for Magic Avatars, plus selfie retouching, object removal, and one-tap effects.
popCaption: 418K US App Store ratings at 4.7 average (apps.apple.com, Lensa AI: Photo Editor, checked Nov 2026). 27.0K web visits to lensa.app in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026); website visits under-count this mobile-first app.
pro: Still a recognizable avatar and portrait app, with a large store rating base
con: Current website traffic is small, and subscription prices are in-app only
costCaption: Editorial estimate for a typical individual paid plan in the $ band. Lensa publishes no public price list; the US App Store lists Unlimited Access from $2.99 for one week and other in-app amounts (apps.apple.com, checked Nov 2026).

name: Topaz Photo
knownFor: A desktop AI photo enhancer (the current product that replaces the older Topaz Photo AI app) for denoise, sharpen, upscale, recover faces, and related finishing tools.
popCaption: 2.7M web visits to topazlabs.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the company site, which also covers other Topaz apps · checked Nov 2026
learn: Desktop enhance, denoise, and upscale for photographers
pro: A serious local/cloud enhancer used by photographers, with a clear official price list
con: The traffic figure is for the Topaz Labs site as a whole, not Photo alone
costCaption: Typical plan: Personal $39/month with no commitment, or $25/month on an annual commitment, or $199/year billed annually (topazlabs.com/topaz-photo, checked Nov 2026). Rated on Personal $39/month.

name: Let's Enhance
knownFor: A web tool for enlarging and fixing images — upscale, unblur, and related enhancement — sold on a credit plan.
popCaption: 649.3K web visits in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
pro: A dedicated enhancer with a clear public credit-plan price list
con: Credit limits mean heavy use may need a higher plan or bundles
costCaption: Typical plan: Pro $32/month, or $24/month billed annually, labeled most popular (letsenhance.io/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Starter is $12/month, or $9/month billed annually.

name: Magnific
knownFor: The Magnific AI upscaler, now part of the Magnific creative platform (formerly Freepik), which also includes stock assets and other AI image and video tools.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. SeekTool’s October 2026 figure of 39.87K visits is for magnific.ai, the former product domain; the product now lives at magnific.com (formerly Freepik), and that site’s mixed stock-and-AI traffic was not used as a clean product figure.
learn: Creative AI upscaling inside a larger suite
pro: Still known for a distinctive generative upscaler, now bundled with a full creative plan
con: No longer a standalone enhancer, so popularity is hard to separate from the wider platform
costCaption: Typical plan: Premium $20/month, or $14.50/month billed annually (magnific.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Plus is labeled best value.
